title: ScorerManifest
description: The supply-chain manifest of one decision scorer (master plan 16.3): provider, model, encoder, revision, file hashes, licence and signature. It is verified before the scorer is loaded and compared with every result (a result from another model or revision is model_mismatch). It describes what the scorer is; it grants nothing, and an unsigned or unverifiable manifest means the scorer is not loaded (fallback reason unavailable or model_mismatch). Hashes are SHA-256 over the exact files the runtime loads. No runtime download of unapproved code is implied.

provider_id.description: The decision provider that runs the scorer.

model_id.description: The scorer model, for example the heads that sit on the encoder.

model_revision.description: The pinned revision of the model.

encoder.description: The encoder the scorer heads sit on.

files.description: Every file the runtime loads, each with its hash. At least one.

licence.description: The licence of the scorer and its encoder.

signature.description: A signature over the manifest, verified before use.

encoder.description: The encoder model and its pinned revision.

encoder_id.description: The encoder, for example a frozen base language model.

revision.description: The pinned revision of the encoder.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the encoder weights when they are a separate file the runtime loads.

fileHash.description: One loaded file and its SHA-256.

name.description: The file name inside the model directory: no path separators.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.

licence.description: A recorded licence and its redistribution terms (master plan 16.3).

spdx_id.description: The SPDX licence identifier, or LicenseRef-<name> for a custom licence.

redistribution.description: Whether AlixAI may redistribute the files. allowed: yes. restricted: only under conditions recorded in url. not_allowed: no, the operator fetches the files.

url.description: Where the licence text is published.

signature.description: A detached signature over the canonical manifest without this member.

algorithm.description: The signature algorithm. Only ed25519 is defined; any other value is rejected on decode.

key_id.description: The ID of the release key that signed, resolved against the trusted key set.

value.description: The signature, standard base64 without line breaks (64 bytes for ed25519).
